hero.headline: Building the regions Viet Nam will live in
hero.subheadline: YUSEA works alongside provinces, cities and communities to shape urban growth that is equitable, low-carbon and locally led.

node.altText: A Vietnamese city skyline at dusk, with high-rise towers under dramatic clouds

statsBand.heading: Why regions matter
statsBand.intro:
Viet Nam is urbanising faster than almost anywhere in Southeast Asia. The decisions made in the next decade will set the shape of its cities for a century.

  • Provinces are drafting the regional plans that will guide investment to 2050.
  • Infrastructure built now will lock in land use, transport and water patterns for generations.
  • Young people will live longest with the outcome, but rarely have a seat at the table.
